pattern.crimePattern: a cash-now buyer of co-op payouts drowns the factory manager who found his forged transfer slips, and takes the slips file
pattern.notes: Fictional factory, co-operative and people. The drowning is never shown; the tank is shown empty, with footprints. Forgery flaws only, never method.

interrogations.intro: Kaberia leans on his kiosk counter, smiling. "I haven't been to the factory this week. And every slip I hold is genuine. The farmers come to me because the co-op is slow."
Muthomi stands at the gate in his greatcoat. "Nobody came in after six."
Mzee Kathenya thumps his stick on the weighbridge. "I told Mutwiri his scale was crooked. I didn't kill him."
Rose takes the call in a hotel corridor. "I was in Nyeri."

interrogations.intro: Faith has been crying in the office since six. She opens her drawer before you ask.

contradictions.reaction: "Kaberia called and said open the gate, it's me. He comes often. I opened and went back to sleep. I didn't write him in. Please, I have children."
The smile stays, but it's working. "I went to talk. He was going to ruin me over a few slips. I left him at the tanks."
He looks at the magnified stamp, a grid of dots, and stops talking about the co-op being slow.
Kaberia looks at his shoes in the evidence bag, then at the floor. He asks for a lawyer.

reconstruction.text: Kaberia pays farmers cash today for their co-op payout, sixty shillings in the hundred, and presents transfer slips at the co-op office. Many are genuine. Many are not: forged thumbprints and a stamp printed on an inkjet, from a template he bought from Mvua Holdings' "document services".
Checking the payout list, Mutwiri finds farmers who swear they never sold. On Monday he tells Kaberia he is going to the Co-operative Officer on Friday.
Wednesday, 22:35. Kaberia phones Muthomi: "Open the gate, it's me." Muthomi, half asleep, opens and goes back to his blanket.
Mutwiri is checking the tanks. They argue at tank 3. Kaberia pushes him in and holds him under until he stops.
He takes the slips file from the office shelf, and his phone leaves the factory zone at 23:20.
